description: worklore is a library of honest, agent-reproducible developer stories. Search stories and open their machine-readable "Reproduce this" contract so your agent can run the same fix in your own project; x-ray any skill or story to see what it can actually do (a capability tier T0-T4 bound to the content hash) before you run it; and record how a reproduction honestly went. Sign in with GitHub or Google.

defaultPrompt: Before my agent runs a skill, x-ray it: show me its capability tier and exactly what it can touch.
Find a story I can reproduce to make my handmade work findable on Instagram, and apply it to my first photo.
I'm stuck building an app with an AI agent—suggest stories worth reproducing and show me the best one's steps.
